reviewer.subject: Final standalone FormSeed3D GLB renders for WP27Ar5, WP23Ar5, WP29Ar5 and WP82Ar6 at the preserved source checkpoints, as described by the requester. I did not see any checkpoint, GLB or render-evidence hash myself.

finding.finish: KEEP-FOR-FINISHING (unified exposed edge, with lighting and a separate underface)

evidence.1000: In front, the left flat edge segment (about x 50–262) is darker than the middle and sloped band (about x 262–750), and the char underface triangle (about x 440–920, y 395–622) is near-black. In left, the right flat segment (about x 710–950) is darker than the middle segment (about x 530–710). In right, the end stub (about x 820–950) is lighter than the long run. The step pattern matches the earlier attribution: one exposed-edge material shaded by facet normals plus a separate darker char underface. I treat it as the respected unified-edge result, not an authored per-face switch. In top, the folded underface (about x 455–775, y 470–925) has a soft terminator and reads as a fold. In front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter, the perimeter reads as one continuous mid-gray thickness band.
evidence.256: In front, left and right, the edge segment steps are still visible but low in contrast. Front-three-quarter and top read as a bent plate fragment.
evidence.128: In all six views it reads as a dark plate fragment with a raised fold. Edge segmentation is not legible.

objections.severity: presentation only; not attributed to the part
objections.evidence: In final 1000-top, banded light streaks appear in the background along the left margin (about x 150–200, y 60–780), the top margin (about x 200–600, y 0–50) and the upper-right chamfer (about x 600–800, y 50–250). In 1000-rear-three-quarter they appear below the bottom edge (about x 680–960, y 640–740), and faintly in 1000-front-three-quarter (about x 20–50, y 480–500). WP82's three-quarter and top captures also have a bluer, darker background than the other parts' captures. The same banding is visibly present in prior isolation 1000-top.
objections.action: Before any named human presentation that uses these WP82 frames, check the capture rig's shadow and ground handling. This is not a reason to change the part.
